column1: # Invented bill-payment texts: no real person, account, card, biller or amount. Tab separated: id, sender, body, expected class, amount in minor units (or empty), kind (or empty).
# Classes: BILL_PAYMENT_PAID | BILL_PAYMENT_RECEIVED | BILL | DEBIT | CREDIT | IGNORED_NOT_A_TRANSACTION | IGNORED_OTP | IGNORED_DECLINED | IGNORED_NOT_ALLOWLISTED
# P rows are confirmations of a bill or card-bill payment (a Transaction, never a Bill). F rows are false friends: each keeps the class the classifier gave it BEFORE bill payments were read

# (recorded by running the unchanged classifier), except F07/F08/F29/F34/F41-F43: a failed, unsuccessful or declined bill payment that asks for nothing is IGNORED_DECLINED, never a bill. One that also says it is due stays a BILL (F44).
